title.value: MolTextQA: A Curated Question-Answering Dataset and Benchmark for Molecular Structure-Text Relationship Learning

abstract.value: Recent advancements in AI have significantly enhanced molecular representation learning, which is crucial for predicting molecule properties and designing new molecules. Despite these advances, effectively utilizing the vast amount of molecular data available in textual form from databases and scholarly articles remains a challenge. Recently, a large body of research has focused on utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) and multi-modal architectures to interpret textual information and link it with molecular structures. Nevertheless, existing datasets often lack specificity in evaluation, as well as direct comparisons and comprehensive benchmarking across different models and model classes. In this work, we construct a dataset specifically designed for evaluating models on structure-directed questions and textual description-based molecule retrieval, featuring over 500,000 question-answer pairs related to approximately 240,000 molecules from PubChem. Its structure enhances evaluation specificity and precision through the use of multiple-choice answers. Moreover, we benchmark various architectural classes fine-tuned using this dataset, including multi-modal architectures, and large language models, uncovering several insights. Our experiments indicate that the Galactica and BioT5 models are the top performers in Molecule QA and Molecule Retrieval tasks respectively, achieving about 70% accuracy. We have made both the dataset and the fine-tuned models publicly available.
